text.en:
The Laguindingan Municipal High School in the Municipality of Laguindingan, province of
Misamis Oriental, is hereby converted into a national High School to be known as the Laguindingan National
High School. Said school shall offer general secondary curriculum, vocational curriculum and other
technological courses.

The amount of two hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture intended
for new national schools. Thereafter the sum necessary for the same purpose shall be included in the annual
General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
